data.title: MeenMitra proposed hybrid pipeline
data.summary: From pond and weather inputs to a demo overnight oxygen-risk index, water-quality rules, simulated alerts and farmer feedback. Statuses below are computed from the running system.

stages.name: Farmer and pond inputs
stages.purpose: Capture each pond's size, depth, species, stocking and equipment so risk reflects that pond.
stages.status_detail: Pond create/list/get/update with validation, stored in local SQLite.
limitations: Biomass is the farmer's estimate; no automated stock tracking.
No authentication or multi-user access control in the MVP.

stages.name: Weather features
stages.purpose: Summarise sunshine, cloud, wind, rain and temperature that drive overnight oxygen balance.
outputs: evening-to-morning weather summary with per-field source
stages.status_detail: Offline synthetic scenario presets in use; Open-Meteo adapter exists but WEATHER_PROVIDER=demo.
limitations: Open-Meteo lookup uses approximate district centroids, not pond coordinates.

stages.name: Physics-inspired baseline
stages.purpose: Simulate the overnight oxygen reserve hour by hour from demand (respiration) and supply (re-aeration, aerators).
stages.status_detail: Deterministic engine demo-0.1.0 with documented assumptions.
limitations: Uncalibrated: constants are demonstration settings, not fitted to measured DO.
Outputs a relative index, never a dissolved-oxygen concentration or crash time.

stages.name: ML correction layer
stages.purpose: Learn systematic errors of the baseline from measured overnight DO and adjust the risk.
stages.status_detail: No correction model is applied to forecasts. Offline experiment state: no_runs.
limitations: No labelled overnight DO series with matching weather exists for the target ponds.
Offline experiments use other datasets/tasks or synthetic data and are not applied.

stages.name: Water-quality and symptom rules
stages.purpose: Flag pH, temperature, ammonia, nitrite, DO and visible symptoms that need attention.
outputs: safe/watch/danger with triggered rules, next steps and referral
limitations: Generic warm-water thresholds; not species- or region-specific.
Never a disease diagnosis; refers medication questions to a fisheries officer.

stages.name: Safe / Watch / Danger classification
stages.purpose: Turn scores and rule results into one actionable level.
stages.status_detail: Forecast: watch ≥ 40.0, danger ≥ 70.0 on the relative index (configurable).
limitations: Boundaries are demonstration settings, not tuned against outcomes.

stages.name: WhatsApp / SMS / voice alerts
stages.purpose: Send localized Kannada and English alerts and record delivery and acknowledgement.
stages.status_detail: Provider 'mock-offline' — offline mock; never contacts phone numbers.
limitations: Real providers need onboarding, approved templates, consent, pricing and DLT/TRAI compliance before use.

stages.name: Farmer feedback and per-pond calibration
stages.purpose: Use what farmers observed at dawn to nudge each pond's demand multiplier.
stages.status_detail: Bounded step adjustment of a per-pond demand multiplier (0.8-1.25). Stress observed after a safe/watch forecast nudges it up (+0.05/+0.03); no stress after a watch/danger forecast nudges it down (-0.01/-0.02). Nights with aerators running, or not checked, cause no change.
limitations: Farmer observations are qualitative and do not measure dissolved oxygen. This demo adjustment is not statistical calibration, is not validated, and never retrains any model automatically.

stages.name: Cooperative monitoring and outbreak reporting
stages.purpose: Aggregate farmer reports by village cluster to spot repeated symptoms early.
outputs: cluster summaries with a follow-up signal
stages.status_detail: Within the window: 3+ distinct ponds reporting the same symptom, or 2+ with the same symptom plus any reported mortality → investigate; 2+ distinct ponds with the same symptom, or any mortality → watch. Demo setting.
limitations: Signal rule is a demonstration setting, not an epidemiological threshold.
A signal prompts follow-up; it does not confirm an outbreak.

status_legend.implemented_demo: Working software running on synthetic or user-entered demo data; not validated.
status_legend.mock: Simulated stand-in for an external service; nothing real is contacted.
status_legend.experimental: Offline experiment; results are not used in the live product flow.
